hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -q '\.go$'; then gofmt -w $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -q '\.py$'; then black --quiet $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS 2>/dev/null; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -q '\.rs$'; then cargo fmt --manifest-path pkg/data_cache/Cargo.toml 2>/dev/null; fi
